primary_metric: per-session median completion-inclusive workload seconds; equal-weight geometric mean of candidate/Flyt ratios
promotion_gate: all correctness/lifecycle checks pass; geometric-mean candidate/Flyt ratio paired bootstrap 95% upper bound <1; every individual workload ratio 95% upper bound <=1.05; no critical copy-path regression; actual VM recovery passes
inferential_unit: independent VM round, not in-process sample
performance_promotion: conditional user authorization; do not promote mixed/inconclusive/losing result

transport_notes.Flyt: ivshmem payload plus RPC control; 4 GiB backing, original chunk policy
transport_notes.VMWeave: 64 MiB backing, 17 MiB per direction arenas, 16 MiB logical copy chunks
transport_notes.interpretation: 128MiB+1 includes different request counts; <=16MiB cases separate relay/copy costs from chunk amplification
